Quick technical notes ahead of the handoff; attaching a few pointers so Sofia can triage internally before the call. These are opinionated recommendations based on your workload (~200k docs, healthcare PII considerations):

Auth
- For local dev: API key stored in .env and bound to a short-lived RBAC role. Docker example uses REDWOOD_API_KEY env var.
- For staging/prod: we recommend mTLS or an OAuth client with token refresh for service accounts. KMS integration available for key rotation.

Routing and Model Variants
- Use routing policy: region-preference -> latency-SLO fallback -> cost tier. Example config in the quickstart shows a policy JSON.
- For embeddings + reranker: start with a 1536-d embedding model (balance performance/cost). If you need higher recall on semantic search, test 3072-d variants in a small subset.

Embeddings Indexing
- Vector store: we’ll provide an example for open-source FAISS (on staging) and a managed Redwood vector index for pilot. Sharding note: keep ~10–20k vectors per shard for fast nearest-neighbor queries.

Reranker
- Use a two-stage retrieval: BM25 (or approximate) -> top-200 candidate embeddings -> reranker model for final sort. Reranker can be run as a small dedicated route (lower latency budget).

Structured output / tool calling
- Recommend using Redwood's tool-calling wrapper (examples in TS + Python). Provide schema enforcement via the structured-output param (we'll include a sample schema for your triage assistant).
- For local tests, use the dry-run flag so actual external tool calls are simulated.

Local testing flow (commands)
- git clone github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-samples
- cp .env.example .env (fill REDWOOD_API_KEY and REGION)
- docker compose up --build (starts a mock index + sample app)
- run samples: python samples/embeddings_demo.py && node samples/structured_call_demo.js

Notes on security/compliance
- We can enable message-level audit logs for the pilot. If you need SOC2 evidence, we’ll surface the compliance pack once procurement engages.

I’ll be on the handoff call. If you want, I can prepare a short Jupyter notebook that runs your own doc subset through the embedding + rerank pipeline.

— Karthik
